build_merged_tree: git fetch origin <branch> <target>; merge origin/<branch> into a scratch worktree cut from the target tip fetched at gate start; go build ./...
focused_vs_full: A -run selector only localizes a failure. The verdict rests on the whole-package run.
zero_match_check: go test -list '<selector>' ./pkg must list the intended tests; go test -list '^TestNoSuchThingAtAll$' ./pkg must list none
